title: Luis Moreno (LMORENO)
summary: Senior buyer (PUR-SR) managing battery packs, chargers, and complete bikes, responsible for UN 38.3 compliance, and approving orders up to £500,000.
body:
Luis Moreno is a Senior buyer in the Purchasing department at Northbridge Cycles, operating under user ID LMORENO and reporting to [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]][^r17]. He acts as the commercial owner and designated buyer for battery packs, battery chargers, and finished bikes, and serves as the purchasing contact for [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3 certificates]][^r1][^r20]. As of 26 October 2026, he enforces compliance controls across battery suppliers, managing onboarding requirements and purchasing holds[^r33][^r46][^r48].

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| User ID | LMORENO |
| Name | Luis Moreno |
| Role | PUR-SR (Senior buyer) |
| Operating unit | NBC-MAN-01 |
| Approval limit | £500,000 gross |
| Default cost centre | [[cc-prd-03|PRD-03]] |
| Supervisor | [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]] (DOKAFOR) |

## Role and responsibilities

Luis Moreno holds the active Ledgerline role PUR-SR in operating unit NBC-MAN-01 with a gross approval limit of £500,000, assigned to default cost centre [[cc-prd-03|PRD-03]][^r17]. In the 2016 intranet directory, he held the role of Buyer at extension 2236[^r21].

He is the assigned buyer in [[data-item-master|ITEM_MASTER_2026-10-26]] for [[items-bat|BAT-* items]] including BAT-500, BAT-500-R, BAT-375, and BAT-750, [[items-chg|CHG-* items]] including charger CHG-4A-01, and [[items-fg|FG-* items]] including finished bike FG-ANC-M-BLK[^r1]. He co-authored the 2024 purchasing induction deck and serves as the department point of contact for suppliers and UN 38.3 certification queries[^r20].

He authors and owns [[sop-pur-005|SOP-PUR-005]] v1.1, which mandates executing monthly batch job JOB-PUR-022 on the first working day of each month with a 90-day window to track expiring battery documentation[^r18][^r19]. Following a battery incident review on 30 July 2026, he agreed to draft [[amd-sup-2026-02|AMD-SUP-2026-02]] to the Supplier Policy, establishing a 12-month window and 60-day margin[^r31].

## Supplier and certificate management

According to [[data-supplier-master|SUPPLIER_MASTER]], Luis Moreno uploaded ISO-9001 quality certificates for multiple suppliers between 2022 and 2025:
* HP-WIG-0928 (certificate ISO9001/42954 on 1 November 2025)[^r2]
* ORP-ODE-0933 (certificate ISO9001/60968 on 1 April 2025)[^r3]
* RMS-HAL-0945 (certificate ISO9001/77253 on 1 February 2023)[^r4]
* GS-WOL-0958 (certificate ISO9001/92128 on 1 May 2022)[^r5]
* DL-SHE-0962 (certificate ISO9001/66184 on 1 March 2022)[^r6]
* VIS-CAR-0984 (certificate ISO9001/95131 on 1 June 2022)[^r7]
* RF-SHE-1022 (certificate ISO9001/20380 on 1 May 2025)[^r8]
* SP-BLA-1031 (certificate ISO9001/34626 on 1 June 2024)[^r9]
* CW-CHA-1074 (certificate ISO9001/71068 on 1 April 2025)[^r10]
* WHA-PRE-1084 (certificate ISO66481/66481 on 1 November 2023)[^r11]
* SF-DOR-1087 (certificate ISO9001/89092 on 1 November 2023)[^r12]
* AL-ARN-1102 (certificate ISO9001/71741 on 1 June 2025)[^r13]
* WL-LEE-1110 (certificate ISO9001/17166 on 1 February 2025)[^r14]
* HES-ROT-1114 (certificate ISO9001/50746 on 1 August 2022)[^r15]
* AHS-ARN-1127 (certificate ISO9001/42015 on 1 March 2024)[^r16]

He actively manages battery vendor relationships, attending the [[sup-vc-ein-0042|Voltway Cells]] review meeting on 17 September 2026 alongside [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]][^r32]. On 14 May 2026, he instructed the purchasing team that Voltway Cells operates under DAP Manchester terms, barring freight line additions on orders and requiring rejection of freight invoices[^r43]. He received price notification on 24 September 2026 fixing the BAT-500 price at £119.00 delivered to Manchester through 31 March 2027[^r44]. 

When [[sup-nc-gda-0063|Nordic Cell Co.]] reported testing delays on 29 September 2026, he issued a directive on 1 October 2026 placing an immediate order freeze on their lithium-cell components following the expiration of certificate UN38.3-TR/NC/2025/090[^r45][^r46]. On 19 October 2026, he was tasked with monitoring Nordic Cell documentation to enforce the hold, while issuing an onboarding pack under [[sop-pur-001|SOP-PUR-001]] and requesting test reports from Brightcell Energy[^r33]. On 23 October 2026, in response to queries from [[user-eclarke|Emma Clarke]] regarding Brightcell's £104.00 quote, he instructed that onboarding proceed while maintaining existing launch orders with Voltway Cells[^r47][^r48].

## Purchasing operations

Moreno executes procurement across multiple commodities and production lines, raising and releasing orders in [[data-po-extract-2026|PO_extract_2026-01_to_2026-10]] and transaction registers:
* Created and self-approved order PO/2026/00557 on 27 April 2026 for £394,800.00 gross (£329,000.00 basic) of [[items-brk|BRK-PAD-01]] from Pennine Brakes (PB-MAN-0017)[^r22].
* Raised PO/2026/00128 on 2 February 2026 to Swale Fixings Limited for 75 units of FST-SCR-M6X10-ZN under [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]][^r23].
* Raised order PO/2026/00277 on 2 March 2026 for 70,000 units of BRK-PAD-01 from Pennine Brakes totaling £764,400.00 gross for PRD-05[^r24].
* Placed series orders PO/2026/00906, PO/2026/00908, PO/2026/00919, PO/2026/00925, PO/2026/00927, PO/2026/00932, PO/2026/00933, PO/2026/00934, PO/2026/00948, PO/2026/00951, PO/2026/00962, and PO/2026/00983 during July 2026[^r25].
* Released PO/2026/01010 on 27 July 2026 for 60,000 units of FST-BLT-M6X8-ZN to Ribble Fixings under [[cc-prd-04|PRD-04]][^r26].
* Raised PO/2026/01023 (£39,600.00 gross) and PO/2026/01030 (£10,206.00 gross) on 30 and 31 July 2026 under PRD-05[^r27].
* Released PO/2026/01175 on 19 October 2026 to Quayside Fixings for 90,000 units of FST-SCR-M10X40-BK totaling £46,440.00 for [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]][^r28].

His broader operational activities include:
* Attending company sales meetings (10 February 2022) and quality reviews (23 May 2026) regarding inventory discrepancies and emergency purchase requests[^r29][^r30].
* Reviewing system supplier performance scores against shop-floor findings (8 August 2019)[^r34].
* Auditing active terms across Manchester and Leeds ERP instances ahead of annual rate reviews (9 September 2019)[^r35].
* Investigating Manchester receipt discrepancies with accounts payable (24 February 2021)[^r36].
* Coordinating overtime and cross-department transfers with [[user-pjansen|Pieter Jansen]] to clear inspection backlogs (3 July 2024)[^r37].
* Handing over purchasing duties to [[user-kmensah|Kwame Mensah]] before leave, including isolating disputed carrier invoices (28 July 2025)[^r38][^r39].
* Aligning bike assembly schedules and packaging demand forecasts with production planners (2 September 2025)[^r40].
* Circulating system vendor lookup guidance to prevent duplicate supplier entries (15 September 2025)[^r41].
* Updating tyre lead-time parameters in Ledgerline ERP following supplier intake issues (7 December 2025)[^r42].

## Versions and conflicts

Today, Luis Moreno is the author and owner of [[sop-pur-005|SOP-PUR-005]] v1.1 governing UN 38.3 certificate renewals[^r18]. In an earlier document, he was listed as the owner of [[sop-pur-001|SOP-PUR-001]] version 2.0 (effective 1 February 2021), which has since been superseded[^r49] (kind: `superseded`).
